chapters.title: Yoto Nature Sleep Sounds - Ko Tao

tracks.title: Yoto Nature Sleep Sounds - Ko Tao

metadata.description: Little Symphony’s music is designed for little listeners to connect with nature around the world. Listen to the calming sounds of Ko Tao, Thailand’s picturesque “Turtle Island.” A vibrant slice of nature, this card weaves together peaceful ambient piano with gentle birdsongs and other soothing sounds of the jungle. Create a beautiful atmosphere for rest and deep relaxation with this card. It can help babies and kids settle down, making bedtime easier, and transform the end-of-day routine. The warmth of the island can also immerse your child in a world of imaginative play, inspire creativity, or ease big emotions to encourage a calm state of mind.
